verdict.rationale: Gladia's models page states language coverage per model ("100+ languages" for the default Solaria-1). The pre-recorded quickstart gives a separate figure for translation ("100 target languages"), which hints at per-feature differences. The pack shows only counts, not an actual published list of languages. missing for 10: a concrete enumerated list of supported languages, explicit per-model language differences (e.g., Solaria-1 vs Solaria-3), per-feature language differences (e.g., live vs async, PII, diarization), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated

citations.quote: Default generalist. 100+ languages, async and live, code switching.
Translation: translate the transcript into one of our 100 target languages.
